findings.reason: the section must state whether the generator flag and the runtime flag are one interface or two, and name what (if anything) is retired or merged, since a plan adding CLI/refusal surface under a 0 budget must account for it in its own text.
findings.text: §2 names one `--mode` surface (the launcher's) but the mode axis also adds `--mode` to the `agent clive` generator command at cli.py:2036-2044, a second CLI option of the same name that the plan text never mentions, so the added interface surface is larger than the section accounts for

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — one `--mode` axis (clive.py:47-58) hides substantial behaviour behind a two-value interface: alias-to-model mapping, curated picker-row generation, per-slot capability declarations, session guidance injection, and the hybrid proxy install all switch on that one argument, so the interface is smaller than what it hides.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — no second owner of the mechanisms the plan touches exists in imas_ambix: a repo-wide search for `SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES`/`modelPicker`/`behavesAs` outside clive.py returns only its own tests, and endpoint-document reading is owned by imas_ambix/agent/registry.py on the publisher side while the launcher consumes it as an external HTTP client, which is a distinct role rather than a fork.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0 (supplied 2026-10-05T05:47:02Z); §2 adds a `--mode` CLI option and an unrecognised-value refusal family and names no existing surface it retires or merges, and it does not account for the companion `--mode` that the generator command `imas-ambix agent clive` gains at cli.py:2036-2044.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §3 measures and cites the two mechanisms it extends (the harness alias slots `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_<ALIAS>_MODEL` and the curated-options settings key with `replaceBuiltInOptions`), and §4 cites the coordinator skill's existing local-backend dispatch path and reuses it rather than rebuilding routing; the launcher already fetches the catalog the rows derive from (clive.py:238, clive.py:507), so no existing mechanism is re-created.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §4 justifies injecting the dispatch statement into the launcher rather than a parallel carrier ("the only component that knows the mapping it just created") and reuses the existing `--worker-profile` settings/`--append-system-prompt` precedent (clive.py:764-774, clive.py:990) instead of adding a second session-settings mechanism.
